scope: Injectable graph loading and parse-only source inventory for CLI and sealed storage. Public reader defaults, standalone native-fast, check --fix and MCP edited-program sessions remain unchanged. No full cutover, performance improvement, package result or full gate pass is claimed.

implementation.native: nativeSourceGraphLoader delegates to ephemeral linkNativeSource on the caller-owned frontend; nativeSourceDependencies uses that same frontend parseUnit
implementation.cli: loadCliProgram guards every injected read; explicit native reads decode UTF-8 fatally. The public historical CLI supplies its existing text adapter.
implementation.sealed: linkSealed, compileSealed, serveUnlocked and protectionCli accept the graph-loading dependency; compiler sourceAccess, authentication, confidentiality/disclosure controls, profile agreement and virtual root confinement are retained.
implementation.inventory: inventory and both sealing re-inventory passes receive the same dependency reader. Genuine native syntax failures are incomplete graphs; malformed UTF-8, allocation/transport refusals and unsupported extensions abort.
implementation.diagnostics: Only already-rendered native diagnostics are hydrated. cliCheckDiagnostic uses the native physical local line and does not reload source or call the historical line locator. Sealed protocol failures expose only a code.
implementation.lifecycle: Borrowed frontend operations are serial; parsing resets live capabilities. No injected frontend is acquired, closed or replaced.
implementation.mcpBoundary: A future MCP session must check/compile its edited in-memory program rather than reloading its original disk graph.

controls: plain CLI and sealed storage use the same borrowed graph loader for a diamond and profile override
native graph entry extension is checked before a storage read
native graph rejects traversal, absolute and symlink imports before outside reads
plain native loading guards sealed policy before injected storage access
fatal plain and sealed UTF8 decoding refuse before native parsing
sealed authentication, migration phase and requested target protection fail before native parsing
native inventory discovers excluded dependencies and retains its reader across migration re-inventory
native inventory records syntax errors while refusing invalid UTF8 and unsupported source extensions
native allocation refusals abort inventory instead of becoming an incomplete graph
native error boundary preserves rendered diagnostic JSON without another source/check call
unlocked native session emits code-only failures and blocks external AI graph loading

regression.optionalSkip: A0_PUBLIC_DENYLIST names no local denylist file
